identity.canonicalName: PISA 2022｜数学认知激活：鼓励数学思考｜中学15岁目标群体｜学生填答（美国英文）
identity.instrumentFamily: PISA 2022 / United States / English / Main Survey / Student Questionnaire

construct.constructDefinition: 数学认知激活：鼓励数学思考；已直接读取美国英文原题本 ST283 共9项及官方技术报告/附表。此记录仅登记官方指数候选，无可执行评分。与同题块的无计分表单是不同使用形态，不重复施测。

population.populationNotes: PISA 原目标为施测时15岁3个月至16岁2个月、7年级及以上学生；整数年龄/7–12年级仅作目录展示，不能替代原精确年龄窗口，7–12为本项目中学候选范围。美国英文独立抽取版未有新效度研究，不外推为全K12或中国常模。

administration.timeFrame: 原题本 This school year 数学课堂教学行为
layoutConstraints: 保留完整 ST283 的9项与美国英文原选项顺序；不从摘要或国际占位符重造题。
矩阵抽样来源；完整题块抽出独立施测不自动等同原PISA设计。
不把题块均分、总和或类别代码当官方IRT/WLE指数。

intendedUses.notes: 来源候选与导入准备；待题项使用范围及独立施测适用性审核。

localization.translationSource: NCES PISA 2022 USA English Student Questionnaire, ST283; not the international master or a Chinese translation.
localization.notes: 实际读题，仅元数据公开。尚未证明独立抽取版测量等价性；中文目录名不是中文版量表。

source.title: PISA 2022 USA Student Questionnaire ST283; COGACMCO technical index
source.citation: NCES/OECD, PISA 2022 USA English Student Questionnaire, ST283; OECD (2025 revised edition), PISA 2022 Technical Report, Chapter 19, Table 19.A.49, https://doi.org/10.1787/01820d6d-en; official 27 June 2024 codebook.

dimensionLabels: 数学认知激活：鼓励数学思考
limitations: Official COGACMCO uses GPCM and WLE; no native executable index or arithmetic substitute installed.
Item identities: ST283Q01JA, ST283Q02JA, ST283Q03JA, ST283Q04JA, ST283Q05JA, ST283Q06JA, ST283Q07JA, ST283Q08JA, ST283Q09JA.
Annex table 19.A.49; reverse-coded item identities before official scaling: none indicated. These are provenance facts, not an executable recoding key.
Higher official index values indicate more frequent perceived encouragement of mathematical thinking.
No individual student/teacher labels, norms, diagnostic thresholds, rankings, or cross-tool total.
Student recipient: describe perceived experience and safe micro-actions; teacher recipient: existing-authorized group summaries only. No new disclosure rights.
Raw descriptive FORM answers stay categorical, including negative-worded items; do not reverse them.
reportPlan.disclaimer: 候选元数据不可施测。无计分表单只保留事实/描述，不生成数字或评分报告。学生填写不表示教师可查看该生个体意见。

blockers: Exact USA English national item redistribution/third-party scope not confirmed; do not publish full questionnaire text.
Existing native scoring path has no verified official PCM/GPCM/WLE reproduction for these sources; no new scoring engine in this task.
Standalone extraction is a project administration change; matrix sampling/context validity not established.
Production database/admin custom-content deduplication remains unverified.
